audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart read Skill on six of seven rows while the content layer (matching packet.levelChart) read Katarina, Katarina, Katarina, Katarina, Akali, Akali, Akali.
audit.why: Two layers rendering different answers to who wins each stage. The content layer matches the packet and the 51.9% Akali win rate — a lane Akali loses early and wins from 6.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Katarina, phases[5..6].side to Akali (phases[4] already Akali). Every phase why rewritten to match its new owner and Katarina's actual cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] claimed Perfect Execution adds 'true damage'.
audit.why: Akali's R deals damage and executes; nothing in the kit makes it true damage. A player itemising against a false true-damage claim builds wrong.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the real reason the first-item spike wins: the second R cast is an execute she cannot blink out of.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the decisive interaction, and named an ability that does not exist ('Bouncing Blade-Sinister Blade combo'). It also justified the late game with 'Shroud denies the reset vision she needs', which is not how Voracity works.
audit.why: Katarina's W is Preparation, not Sinister Blade. Voracity resets her cooldowns when a champion she damaged dies — it is a kill trigger, not a vision mechanic, so Shroud does not deny it. The decisive facts are: Shunpo (725 range, 12s at rank 1, 8s maxed) is her only exit and it can target her own daggers, so a dropped dagger is a free step onto you; and Death Lotus is a 550-range channel, which you leave by walking rather than by racing.
audit.corrected: Fight away from her daggers; commit inside the 12s after Shunpo; step outside 550 when Death Lotus starts; kill the target she wants Voracity to fire off.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/E/R text, ranges and cds

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Shunpo but gave no numbers and told you to 'hard CC during her resets'.
audit.why: Akali has no hard CC — her Q is a slow. Advice she cannot execute is worse than no advice. The usable number is that Shunpo leaves her without an exit for up to 12s.
audit.corrected: Shunpo 12s/8s, Bouncing Blade 11s at zero cost, Death Lotus 75s and 550 range, all written in with the sequencing they imply.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file's derived flags list 'grounding' on Bouncing Blade and 'knockup' on Preparation.
audit.why: Riot's own descriptions say only that Q bounces between enemies and ricochets onto the ground, and that W gives move speed and tosses a dagger above herself. Neither text supports grounding or a displacement, so these read as tooltip-parse misfires. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted neither — an Akali told her E and R are grounded by Q would misplay every trade.
audit.corrected: Nothing written about grounding or knockups anywhere in the proposal.

notes: Ability-name error confirmed from packet.suspectNames: spikes[0] said 'Bouncing Blade-Sinister Blade combo'. Sinister Blade is not in her kit — her W is Preparation — so the line was rebuilt around the real interaction (Q drops a dagger, Shunpo can blink to it). Two other false claims removed: Perfect Execution described as true damage, and 'Shroud denies her reset vision' (Voracity is a champion-death cooldown reset, not vision). Derived-flag misfires NOT written to the page: the kit file tags Bouncing Blade with 'grounding' and Preparation with 'knockup', neither of which appears in Riot's descriptions; asserting grounding would tell an Akali her E and R are shut off by a Q that does not do that. Also removed 'hard CC during her resets' — Akali has no hard CC, only the Q slow.
